packageRules.description: D-042 (dvystrcil/homelab architecture/ways-of-working.md): our own actions follow their semver tag (e.g. @v1) so a fix ships by moving the tag, without a digest PR per repo. Third-party actions stay digest-pinned. Must come after helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests, which it overrides.
Group routine patch updates for a smaller review queue
